req.title: Create new post
req.statement: The system shall insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user when POST /create receives a title and body, then redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /create must insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user and redirect to /. I design: (1) a positive EP test confirming 302 redirect and DB row insertion with correct author_id; (2) a negative NEG test confirming unauthenticated access redirects to login (not 302 to /); (3) a boundary BVA test with a single-character title (minimum non-empty title); (4) a DT test with empty title (validation failure, no redirect, no DB insert); (5) a STC test verifying the state transition from logged-in to post-created to redirect-to-index. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_create_post_authenticated_redirects_and_inserts
preconditions: App initialized with test database containing fixture user id=1 (username=test, password=test)
actions: POST /create with title='Hello World' and body='Some body text'
expected: Database contains a new post row with title='Hello World', body='Some body text', author_id=1
trace: R-FLASKR-015: POST /create with title+body inserts row and redirects to /
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_create_post_authenticated_redirects_and_inserts():
    login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert login_r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Hello World', 'body': 'Some body text'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        post = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM post WHERE title = ? AND body = ?",
            ('Hello World', 'Some body text')
        ).fetchone()
    assert post is not None
    assert post['title'] == 'Hello World'
    assert post['body'] == 'Some body text'
    assert post['author_id'] == 1

test_create_post_authenticated_redirects_and_inserts()

actions: POST /create with title='Hello' and body='Body' without prior login

tests.name: test_create_post_author_id_matches_logged_in_user
preconditions: App initialized with test database containing fixture users id=1 (test) and id=2 (other)
actions: POST /create with title='Other Post' and body='Other body'
expected: Database contains a new post row with author_id=2 (not 1)
trace: R-FLASKR-015: post must be attributed to the logged-in user (author_id must equal g.user['id'])
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_create_post_author_id_matches_logged_in_user():
    login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'other', 'password': 'other'})
    assert login_r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Other Post', 'body': 'Other body'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        post = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM post WHERE title = ?", ('Other Post',)
        ).fetchone()
    assert post is not None
    assert post['author_id'] == 2
    assert post['author_id'] != 1
    assert post['title'] == 'Other Post'
    assert post['body'] == 'Other body'
